name: Concealed Position
text: The hot-shot marksman rifle's concealed profile can only be used in the Sharpshooter's first Shoot action of the battle.

name: TACTICAL COMMAND
text: Free action (not in an enemy control range). Pick any friendly Kasrkin and give it one Skill at Arms it does not already have until the Ready step of the next Strategy phase; a second use on the same operative replaces the first. Or, if your Clearance Sweep marker is in play, pick it up and place it again anywhere.

name: Veteran Leadership
text: While the Sergeant is in the killzone, the Skill at Arms gambit lets you pick two different skills instead of one.

name: Medic!
text: The first time each turning point a friendly Kasrkin within 3 inches that this operative can see would go down (neither of them in an enemy control range), it is kept on 1 wound and cannot be taken down for the rest of that action. After the action it may Dash into the Combat Medic's control range, both then have -1 APL until their next activations end, and if it happened in the casualty's own activation that activation ends. Not while the Combat Medic is down or is itself a target of that Shoot.

name: MEDIKIT
text: Free action (not in an enemy control range). A friendly Kasrkin in this operative's control range, itself included, regains up to 2D3 lost wounds. Whoever Medic! saved this turning point cannot be treated.

name: Melta Mine
text: The Demo-Trooper starts the battle carrying your Melta Mine marker, and only it can pick the marker up again. It sets the mine down with the Place Marker action (never within an enemy control range) and may then take a free Dash. If it falls while carrying the mine and there is no legal spot for it, the marker goes with it.

name: Proximity Mine
text: The first time a placed Melta Mine marker is within the control range of any operative other than the Demo-Trooper (friend or foe), it is removed and that operative takes 2D6+3 damage. If it survives, whatever action it was performing stops there, unfinished.

name: Blast Padding
text: When shot with a Blast or Torrent weapon (unless that weapon has a sweeping profile) the Demo-Trooper may re-roll one defence die, and Devastating damage with a distance never reaches it unless it is the target.

name: Reconnoitre Killzone
text: RELOCATE costs 0 CP when this operative is the one it picks first.

name: AUSPEX SCAN
text: Not in an enemy control range. Until this operative next activates (or is incapacitated), every enemy within 8 inches of it is scanned: friendly Kasrkin shooting a scanned enemy ignore the obscured status.

name: Camo Cloak
text: While shot, the Sharpshooter ignores Saturate and, if it can retain any cover saves, retains one more or retains one as a crit (not stacking with the Vantage improvement).

name: Adaptive Equipment
text: Once per turning point one friendly Trooper may perform Smoke Grenade, and once per turning point one may perform Stun Grenade, without using your grenade equipment.

name: BATTLE COMMS
text: Not in an enemy control range. Another friendly Kasrkin gets +1 APL until the end of its next activation, never taking it above 3. The Vox-Trooper may perform this twice in one activation.

name: RAPID FIRE
text: A Kasrkin that performs no action in which it moves in its activation may Shoot twice, provided both Shoots use a bolt pistol, hot-shot lasgun or hot-shot laspistol. Guard cannot be one of the two, and after two Shoots it cannot move or Guard.

name: Light 'Em Up
text: Skill at Arms. The operative's ranged weapons have Severe.

name: Strike Fast
text: Skill at Arms. +1 inch of Move while the operative performs Reposition (free Repositions included).

name: Ice In Your Veins
text: Skill at Arms. While the operative fights, retaliates or is shot, the first attack die of that sequence that would deal it Normal Dmg 3 or more deals 1 less. Crits and Devastating damage are never reduced.

name: For Cadia!
text: Skill at Arms. The operative's melee weapons get Atk +1 (to no more than 4), and its first strike when it fights (not retaliating) deals 1 extra damage.
